On AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950, terminal capture preserved a GPU-computed pre-norm residual stream and exactly matched an independently constructed CPU tensor. Raw output: raw/gpu_boundary_check.log.

remaining_limitations: Qwen3.5-4B weights, Ascend hardware, and a multi-node FlashInfer MNNVL environment were unavailable. No full serving/model, Ascend, semantic-accuracy, or distributed-workload claim is made. The deferred-finalization regression exercises the actual handoff type and model forward branch with a deterministic fake finalizer; the GPU check validates only the device-independent terminal residual-stream capture. No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
